wave.definition: A moving disturbance in the level of a body of liquid; an undulation.

way.definition: To do with a place or places.

ways.definition: Form of way (plural): To do with a place or places.

wearing.definition: Form of wear (gerund participle present): To have on.

weather.definition: To expose to the weather, or show the effects of such exposure, or to withstand such effects.

week.definition: Any period of seven consecutive days.

weekday.definition: Any individual day of the week, except those which form the weekend or the single weekly day off; that is.

weekend.definition: The break in the working week, usually two days including the traditional holy or sabbath day. Thus in Western countries, Saturday and Sunday.

weeks.definition: Form of week (plural): Any period of seven consecutive days.

welcome.definition: To affirm or greet the arrival of someone, especially by saying "Welcome!".

went.definition: Form of go (past): To move, either physically or in an abstract sense.

were.definition: Form of be (indicative past second-person singular): As an auxiliary verb.

weren’t.definition: Form of were (abbreviation contraction): Form of be (indicative past second-person singular): As an auxiliary verb.

wet.definition: Made up of liquid or moisture, usually (but not always) water.

what.definition: In what way; to what extent.

whatshisname.definition: Form of what's-his-name (alternative): A passing (male) acquaintance of no importance or relevance.

what’s.definition: In what way; to what extent.

wheelbarrow.definition: A small, one-wheeled (or rarely, two-wheeled) cart with handles at one end for transporting small loads.

when.definition: At what time? At which time? Upon which occasion or circumstance? Used to introduce direct or indirect questions about time.

where.definition: In, at or to what place.

wherever.definition: Where ever; an emphatic form of where.

where’s.definition: In, at or to what place.

while.definition: An uncertain duration of time, a period of time.

whirlwind.definition: A windstorm of limited extent, such as a tornado, dust devil, or waterspout, characterized by an inward spiral motion of the air with an upward current in the center; a vortex of air.

whisper.definition: The act of speaking in a quiet voice, especially without vibration of the vocal cords; the sound thus produced.

whispering.definition: Something that is whispered; gossip; a rumor.

whistling.definition: Form of whistle (gerund participle present): To make a shrill, high-pitched sound by forcing air through the mouth. To produce a whistling sound, restrictions to the flow of air are created using the teeth, tongue and li.

white.definition: Bright and colourless; reflecting equal quantities of all frequencies of visible light.

who.definition: A person under discussion; a question of which person.

who’s.definition: A person under discussion; a question of which person.

why.definition: Form of wye (alternative): The name of the Latin script letter Y/y.

wicked.definition: Evil or mischievous by nature; morally reprehensible.

wickedness.definition: The state of being wicked; evil disposition; immorality.

wicker.definition: A flexible branch or twig of a plant such as willow, used in weaving baskets and furniture.

widow.definition: A person whose spouse is absent.

widower.definition: A man whose spouse has died (and who has not remarried); a man in relation to his late spouse; masculine of widow.

wife.definition: A married woman, especially in relation to her spouse.

wigs.definition: Form of wig (plural): A head of real or synthetic hair worn on the head to disguise baldness, for cultural or religious reasons, for fashion, or by actors to help them better resemble the character they are portraying.

wildcat.definition: A cat that lives in the wilderness, specifically.

will.definition: Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

willing.definition: Form of will (gerund participle present): Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.

wind.definition: Real or perceived movement of atmospheric air usually caused by convection or differences in air pressure.

window.definition: An opening, usually covered by one or more panes of clear glass, to allow light and air from outside to enter a building or vehicle.

wine.definition: An alcoholic beverage made by fermenting grape juice, with an ABV ranging from 5.5–16%.

wings.definition: Form of wing (plural): An appendage of an animal's (bird, bat, insect) body that enables it to fly.

wire.definition: To fasten with wire, especially with reference to wine bottles, corks, or fencing.

wisdom.definition: An element of personal character that enables one to distinguish the wise from the unwise.

with.definition: Form of withe (alternative): A flexible, slender shoot or twig, especially when used as a band or for binding; a withy.

withdrawing.definition: Form of withdraw (gerund participle present): To draw or pull (something) away or back from its original position or situation.

withered.definition: Form of wither (participle past): To shrivel, droop or dry up, especially from lack of water.

withering.definition: Form of wither (gerund participle present): To shrivel, droop or dry up, especially from lack of water.

within.definition: In or into the interior; inside.

witness.definition: Attestation of a fact or event; testimony.

women.definition: Form of woman (plural): An adult female human.

wonder.definition: A sense of awe, astonishment and curiosity, inspired by unexpected events, novel experiences and inexplicable circumstances, sometimes accompanied by surprise, shock or reverence.

wonderful.definition: Tending to excite wonder; surprising, extraordinary.

won’t.definition: Will not (negative auxiliary); used to indicate a future non-occurring action.

woods.definition: Form of wood (plural): The substance making up the central part of the trunk and branches of a tree. Used as a material for construction, to manufacture various items, etc. or as fuel.

word.definition: The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)

work.definition: To do a specific task by employing physical or mental powers.

worktable.definition: A table designed for work of a specific type.

world.definition: The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

world’s.definition: The subjective human experience, regarded collectively; human collective existence; existence in general; the reality we live in.

worn.definition: Form of wear (participle past): To have on.

worse.definition: Form of bad (comparative): Of low quality.

worst.definition: Superlative form of bad: most bad.

would.definition: Past tense of will; usually followed by a bare infinitive.

wounded.definition: Form of wound (participle past): To hurt or injure (someone) by cutting, piercing, or tearing the skin.

wounding.definition: Form of wound (gerund participle present): To hurt or injure (someone) by cutting, piercing, or tearing the skin.

wrap.definition: To enclose (an object) completely in any flexible, thin material such as fabric or paper.

wretch.definition: An unhappy, unfortunate, or miserable person.

wretched.definition: Characterized by or feeling deep affliction or distress; very miserable.

wrinkled.definition: Form of wrinkle (participle past): To make wrinkles in; to cause to have wrinkles.

wrinkles.definition: Form of wrinkle (plural): A small furrow, ridge or crease in an otherwise smooth surface.

wrist.definition: The complex joint between forearm bones, carpus, and metacarpals where the hand is attached to the arm; the carpus in a narrow sense.

write.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

writes.definition: Form of write (indicative present singular third-person): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

writhing.definition: Form of writhe (gerund participle present): To twist, wring (something).

writing.definition: Form of write (gerund participle present): To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

year.definition: Form of here (pronunciation-spelling): This place; this location.

years.definition: Form of year (plural): A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

yell.definition: To shout; holler; make a loud sound with the voice, especially to express intense emotions such as anger or excitement.

yelled.definition: Form of yell (participle past): To shout; holler; make a loud sound with the voice, especially to express intense emotions such as anger or excitement.

yelling.definition: Form of yell (gerund participle present): To shout; holler; make a loud sound with the voice, especially to express intense emotions such as anger or excitement.

yes.definition: An affirmative expression; an answer that shows agreement or acceptance.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: Offspring, especially the immature offspring of animals.

youngest.definition: Form of young (superlative): In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

youths.definition: Form of youth (plural): The quality or state of being young.
